name: pi05-benchmark-120tasks
description: A collection of 120 short NLP tasks designed to probe language models across instruction following, reasoning, and generation scenarios. Tasks cover a mix of classification, question answering, and free-form generation intended to evaluate generalization and robustness across diverse prompts.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on HuggingFace with limited but growing use by practitioners experimenting with multi-task evaluation suites.
